steps: You stay at the clinic for treatment and witness Coronis's remarkable skills. Will it be enough to heal you...?
Doc, doc, this must be something serious, right?
So you're feeling tired and have no appetite. How did you figure out from just that there's something wrong with your brain?
Well, a few days ago, I had a headache all day and a low fever.
On top of that, I couldn't sleep and felt totally drained...
Doctor, stop fudging and just tell me the truth...! ==W==Do I have some kind of brain disease? I've asked around!
Hmph ... ==W==Sounds like you went to see some "famous specialist," huh?
Aside from the brain stuff, I think it might also be a mental disorder.
Uh ... Doc ... Is there ...==W== any hope for me at all...?
Hmm, I've got the special cure right here. Hold on.
Ah! So I can be cured! I'm saved! Thank you, Doc!
Assistant, hand me those red-capped vials.
Is this even a proper diagnosis? Seems way too simple...
While I'm hesitating, Coronis gives me a look that says, "It's fine, go ahead and give him the medicine." Questions notwithstanding, I do as she says and take out the vials from the box.
Take one in the morning and one at night for a week. Stick to light food, no meat.
My assistant will check in with you in a week.
Doc, you want me to do the follow-up?
No way! I don't have a lick of medical knowledge!
A patient who isn't actually sick is perfect for an assistant who doesn't have any medical knowledge.
The medicine I gave him is just plain water with a bit of bitter flavor added. Once his anxiety eases, he'll get better on his own.
That was just literally playing doctor for him. Getting a real doctor to do that, though, is a bit much.
Now prepare yourself.==W== Our real challenge for today is Patient No. 68. Hehe~
He has a rare case of tremor syndrome.
Hehe ... At first I thought his symptoms were just temporary withdrawal effects from quitting alcohol.
But during my last I found out he had relatives with the same problem.
So I suspect he might have hereditary tremor syndrome.
If that's really the case ...==W== He'd make a fascinating research specimen ... Hehe. Ah, I'm getting excited just thinking about it. Makes me want to dissect a frog right now.
And she's even talking about dissections and stuff ...==W== Could she really mean it...?
I told you, I've been feeling a lot better! I don't need to go see you!
So you started drinking again, huh?
Even more than before, it looks like.
One day, when your symptoms flared up, you realized that drinking actually stopped the shaking.
So, you had a reason to start drinking again.
But over time, you realized that you need more and more alcohol to keep the tremors at bay.
But the truth is, it just felt like you stopped shaking because you were drunk ...==W== You really are a handful, you know that?
Whatever! I'm not going to your clinic!
Of course, I won't force a patient to undergo treatment. If anything, if you just give up, it will be a boon for me~
If the patient refuses treatment while alive, I have a better chance of doing a pathological autopsy on the body later—maybe even turning it into a specimen for further study, hehe~
If you want to know ... ==W==How I dissect and prepare those specimens...
W-wait! I-I want to get treatment! I don't want to know anything about that!!
But ... If you don't want to end up getting dissected or turned into a specimen,==W== better cooperate.
Hehehe ...==W== Finally, the moment I've been waiting for ...
The happy opportunity to dissect you and do whatever I want with you.
Wait, what? Dissect me? What are you...?!
See these bone shears? They let me cut through the ribs after separating the muscles to remove organs like the heart and lungs.
Hehe ... Just imagining the feeling of snipping through your bones—snap, snap—is enough to get me excited ... Hehehe.
This surgical saw is brand new, too. See how it's covered in tiny teeth, so small you can barely see them with the naked eye?
But rest assured, I'll be extra careful. I'll remove the brain completely intact.

As long as I preserve your brain and organs in fixative and change the solution regularly ... You will have to stay by my side forever, till the day that I die. Hehe ... hehehe. Isn't that kind of romantic?
Oh, of course, I'd take good care of your bones too. I will turn them into a proper skeleton display. Let me think ... I'd keep them by my bedside, right next to my favorite specimens.
That way ...==W== Neither of us will be lonely.
Hehehe ...==W== Just thinking about it gets me feeling all warm and fuzzy. You feel it too, right?
This is nothing like warm fuzzy! It's pure cold sweat! Stop, Coronis! You don't know what you're doing!
I know perfectly what I am doing, hehe, hehehe~~
No! NOOOOOOO—!!!==W== Huff ... Huff ... I'm so glad it was just a dream...
It was way too vivid for comfort though ...==W== Maybe it's because of all those morbid things I heard during her house calls today...
It's still the middle of the night. Hm...?==W== The light is still on in Coronis' room...?
A soft, warm light spilled from the room. Maybe it was that light that chased away the shadow of the nightmare I just had.
I peek quietly into the room, and the person from my dream is sitting right there.
She has a gentle expression on her face as she flips through a thick stack of papers on the desk.
Coro ... nis...? You are still up?
